scripts.build: pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/tokens build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/presentations build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/react build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/react-native build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/docs build
scripts.check: pnpm tokens:validate && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/tokens build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/presentations build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/react build && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/react-native check && pnpm --filter @arcsyn-io/docs build
scripts.packages:check: publint packages/tokens --strict && publint packages/presentations --strict && publint packages/styles --strict && publint packages/icons --strict && publint packages/react --strict && publint packages/react-native --strict
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm packages:check && pnpm licenses:check
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm packages:check && changeset publish
